name.en-US: The Little Book of Eternal Wisdom

description.en-US: Suso's dialogue between the Servant and Eternal Wisdom on the Passion, suffering, death and the praise of God, in the English of the Richardson edition (1866), after Diepenbrock's German. The Middle High German original (Bihlmeyer 1907) is not yet imported.
description.pt-BR: O diálogo de Suso entre o Servo e a Sabedoria Eterna sobre a Paixão, o sofrimento, a morte e o louvor a Deus, na tradução inglesa da edição Richardson (1866).

sources.edition: Blessed Henry Suso's Little Book of Eternal Wisdom (London and Derby: Richardson and Son, 1866).
sources.description: OCR of the archive.org (Google) scan, research/sourcing/_scripts/suso_en.py; running heads removed. Translator's preface and the contents are not included. Not proofread.
